description_ru: Смешная история человека, который никак не может встать утром, и его семи попыток победить будильник.
text:
I hate waking up early. My brain does not work before ten o'clock, and my body agrees with it. The problem is that my job starts at eight. So every night I fight a war against the morning, and my weapon is an alarm clock. This war is long and difficult. Here is the story of how I am losing it.

On Monday I use my phone. I put it next to my bed and set the alarm for seven. At seven o'clock a nice little song starts to play. It is so quiet and so sweet that I think it is a part of my dream. I turn around and sleep again. When I open my eyes, it is nine fifteen. My boss is not happy. He says, "You are late." I say, "My alarm is too nice." He does not laugh.

On Tuesday I buy a loud alarm clock. It is old and metal, with two bells on the top, and it sounds like a fire. The next morning I jump out of bed with fear, and my heart is beating very fast. I am awake! I am a winner! I turn the clock off, and I am so happy that I lie down again, just for one second. Two hours later, my neighbour is knocking on the wall. He says that my clock is crying, and it is nine o'clock.

On Wednesday I make a new plan. I put the alarm clock across the room, on the shelf near the window. Now I must stand up and walk to turn it off. At seven o'clock the bells start. I get up, I cross the room, and I stop the noise. I am very proud of myself. Then I look at my bed. It is warm and soft, and it says, "Come back." I am not a strong person. I go back to bed and sleep until nine.

On Thursday I ask my sister for help. She is a morning person, and she wakes up at six every day without any machine. It is a mystery to me. She says, "I call you at seven, and I do not stop until you speak." That sounds perfect. At seven she calls, and I answer in a sleepy voice, "Yes, I am up." She says, "Good." Then I put the phone on the pillow, and I sleep again. My sister is not stupid. She calls five more times, and I do not hear any of them.

On Friday I am desperate. I go to the shop and ask for a special clock. The shop assistant shows me a clock that runs away. It has little wheels, and when the alarm starts, it drives around the room and hides. You must find it to stop the noise. I buy it, and I am excited. The next morning, the clock starts to run at seven. I chase it around the flat. It goes under the sofa, behind the door and into the kitchen. After ten minutes, I am awake, tired, and a little angry, and the clock is sitting in my shoe.

At first I think this is the best thing in the world. I am on time, and I even have time for breakfast. But on Saturday and Sunday I do not need to go to work, and the clock does not know. At seven o'clock it starts to run again. It crashes into my bed, it falls from the table, and it cries all over the flat. I want to sleep, and the little machine laughs at me. I put it in the freezer, and I finally sleep until noon. It is a terrible thing to do, but I am happy.

Now it is Monday again, and I need a new idea. My friend Dan says, "Go to bed earlier." I look at him as if he is crazy. Go to bed earlier? It is a ridiculous idea. At ten o'clock in the evening, I am awake and full of energy. I watch films, I eat cheese, and I answer messages. I am a night person, and I cannot change.

So this morning I do something new. I do not use any alarm at all. Instead, I ask the sun for help. I open the curtains before I sleep, and now the light comes in at six thirty. It works! I wake up, I see the sun, and I feel fine. Then I notice that it is raining and the sky is dark. The sun is on holiday, and I am late again. Maybe I should look for a job that starts at noon.

questions.question: What time does the writer's job start?
What happens with the metal alarm clock?
questions.answer: The writer turns it off and sleeps again, and the neighbour knocks on the wall.

questions.question: What is special about the clock from the shop?
questions.answer: It runs away and hides when the alarm starts.

questions.question: What is the writer's last idea?
questions.answer: To open the curtains and let the sun wake him.
